THE DESTINATION

About McLeodganj & Triund

A trip to McLeodganj and the Triund trek offers the perfect blend of spirituality, culture, and adventure in the heart of Himachal Pradesh. McLeodganj, known for its Tibetan influence, peaceful monasteries, and vibrant streets, sets the tone for a soulful escape. From here begins the scenic trek to Triund — a moderately challenging hike that rewards you with breathtaking views of the Dhauladhar range and the Kangra Valley.

Surrounded by lush forests and cool mountain air, camping at Triund under a starlit sky is a truly magical experience. This trip is ideal for nature lovers and adventure seekers craving a refreshing Himalayan getaway.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Explore the Tibetan culture — and vibrant streets of McLeodganj.

Visit the spiritual Dalai Lama Monastery — a peaceful, sacred space.

Cafe hopping — and the McLeodganj flea market for local handicrafts.

Trek to Triund — the crown jewel of Dharamshala.

Panoramic views — of the Dhauladhar range and Kangra Valley.

Camp under a starlit Himalayan sky — at Triund, with bonfire and music.

Dharamshala Cricket Stadium & tea gardens — on the way back down.

Bhagsu Waterfall — and cozy hillside cafes.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Assembly: The group will assemble at the pickup point in the evening.
  • Briefing: Afterward, you'll get a small briefing from the Trip Leader(s).
  • Journey: Overnight journey towards McLeodganj.
  • En Route: Halt for dinner in between (not included).
  • Arrival: Arrive in McLeodganj and check in to your hotel, taking some time to freshen up and relax.
  • Flea Market: Head out to explore the vibrant McLeodganj flea market, perfect for local handicrafts and souvenirs.
  • Sightseeing: Visit the serene Bhagsu Waterfall, experience the spiritual aura of the Dalai Lama Monastery, and unwind at cozy hillside cafes.
  • Evening: Return to the hotel, enjoy a delicious dinner, and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay.
  • Breakfast: Freshen up and enjoy a hearty breakfast to prepare for the day.
  • Trek Begins: Begin the trek to Triund, the crown jewel of Dharamshala nestled in the Dhauladhar mountains.
  • Views: Experience stunning panoramic views of the Dhauladhar range on one side and Kangra Valley on the other.
  • Arrival: Reach Triund by evening and check in to your campsite.
  • Evening: Enjoy a warm dinner followed by an overnight stay under the stars.
  • Breakfast: Rise early and enjoy a hearty breakfast.
  • Descent: Begin your descent trek towards McLeodganj.
  • Sightseeing: Upon arrival, explore the serene Dalai Lama Temple, take a stroll around the Dharamshala Cricket Stadium, and wander through the lush tea gardens.
  • Departure: Wrap up the journey with your return departure by evening.

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Entire travel as per the itinerary
  • Accommodation in deluxe hotel & dorm camps
  • 4 meals — Day 1 dinner, Day 2 breakfast & dinner, Day 3 breakfast

Not included in your package

  • GST 5% extra
  • Lunch during the trip
  • Any other costing due to natural calamity or forced circumstances out of our control
  • Entry fees / camera fees for entering any monument
  • Medical expenses (apart from first aid) and insurance of any kind
  • Tips, laundry, liquors, wines, mineral water, telephone charges, items of personal nature
